fields.System.Title: INV-303 — Prevent negative stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want any operation that would take stock below zero to be rejected, so
that an impossible number never enters the system and gets built upon.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a source with 5 units, when a move of 8 is attempted, then it is rejected —
  • not clamped to zero.
  • - Given the rejection, then the error states the requested and available quantities.
  • - Given the database, then a check constraint enforces qty_on_hand >= 0 as a backstop.
  • - Given the database, then a check constraint enforces
  • 0 <= qty_reserved <= qty_on_hand.
  • - Given any sequence of operations in a test, then the invariant holds afterwards.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance |
| Risks | Clamping hides the bug that caused it ([doc 09 §2.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · property/invariant |
